text.text:
Aninda Studio is one person making simple apps for real life.

Everything here is built on a design system where the claims are measured rather than asserted. Every colour pairing was measured against every surface it can land on, in a real browser, and the published figure is the worst result rather than the flattering one. Where something has a limit, the limit is written down.

Almost nothing here is written by hand. The colours, the type ramp, the spacing, the icons and the words that describe them are generated from one set of tokens, and a check refuses to finish if any of them drifts from it.

This listing describes the studio. No app is published yet.
Simple apps for real life, from a one-person studio.

play-adaptive-icon.spec: Android adaptive icon, three layers at 108 x 108 dp, safe zone 66 x 66 dp centred, 18 dp per side reserved
play-adaptive-icon.quote: The outer 18 dp on each of the four sides of the layers is reserved for masking and to create visual effects such as parallax or pulsing.
play-adaptive-icon.note: Declared at res/mipmap-anydpi-v26/ic_launcher.xml. The monochrome layer supports user theming from Android 13, API level 33.

play-feature-graphic.spec: Google Play feature graphic, 1024 x 500 px, JPEG or 24-bit PNG, no alpha. Mandatory to publish
play-feature-graphic.quote: You must provide a feature graphic to publish your store listing. JPEG or 24-bit PNG (no alpha). Dimensions: 1024 px by 500 px.
play-feature-graphic.note: Android's core app quality criterion Play_Feature_Graphic adds that it must not contain device images or screenshots, must not carry small text that becomes illegible when scaled down, and must not resemble an advertisement.

play-icon.spec: Google Play app icon, 512 x 512 px, 32-bit PNG, sRGB, under 1024 KB, full square
play-icon.quote: Final size: 512 px by 512 px. Format: 32-bit PNG. Color space: sRGB. Max file size: 1024 KB. Shape: Full square — Google Play dynamically handles masking.
play-icon.note: Google Play applies a corner radius equivalent to 30 per cent of the icon size, which is 153.6 px on a 512 px asset, and adds the drop shadow itself. Neither is baked in here.

play-listing-text.spec: Google Play listing text: title 30 characters, short description 80, full description 4000
play-listing-text.quote: Character limits apply to both full-width and half-width characters.
play-listing-text.note: The Metadata policy bans ranking or price claims, Play programme labels, emoji and repeated special characters in the title, and capitals other than a brand name.

play-screenshot-phone.spec: Google Play phone screenshot, JPEG or 24-bit PNG, no alpha, minimum side 320 px, maximum 3840 px, longer side no more than twice the shorter. At least two are mandatory to publish
play-screenshot-phone.quote: You must provide a minimum of two screenshots across different device types to publish your store listing.
play-screenshot-phone.note: Google recommends at least four at 1080 px minimum, either 16:9 landscape or 9:16 portrait. 1080 x 1920 is the portrait figure and is what the frames here are drawn at.

recorded_conflicts.conflict: Play Console asks for a 32-bit PNG with alpha; the icon design specification says to avoid transparency and use a brand background colour.
recorded_conflicts.reading: A 32-bit PNG whose artwork is opaque edge to edge.
recorded_conflicts.measured: Four bands present, and every corner alpha 255.

recorded_conflicts.conflict: The 18 dp reserve on each side leaves 72 dp, yet the safe zone is published as 66 dp.
recorded_conflicts.reading: Both are published and they describe different things. 108 minus twice 18 is the 72 dp viewport the system displays; the 66 dp safe zone sits inside that, inset a further 3 dp per side.
recorded_conflicts.measured: The guard enforces 66 dp, the stricter of the two.

recorded_conflicts.conflict: "1024 KB" does not say whether KB is 1000 or 1024 bytes.
recorded_conflicts.reading: 1 024 000 bytes, the smaller of the two readings.
recorded_conflicts.measured: The actual byte count of every file is recorded, so the other reading can be checked without rebuilding.

recorded_conflicts.conflict: Google asks for a logo of at least 48 dp and does not say whether that is height, width or the longest dimension.
recorded_conflicts.reading: This mark is taller than it is wide, so the reading decides the answer. At the scale that keeps every inked pixel inside the safe circle it measures 43.89 x 49.29 dp: it meets 48 dp on its long axis and not on its short one.
recorded_conflicts.measured: Recorded rather than designed away. Fitting the 66 dp square instead would meet both and would put ink outside the circle a round launcher mask leaves.
